The '''TH-17A Elite War Medic''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that was heavily used by both the [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian clans]] and elite [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. It would still remain in usage during the [[war against Zakuul]] by the Mandalorians loyal to the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mand'alor]], [[Mandalore the Avenger]].
